description.uz: Xususiy klinikalar uchun multi-tenant navbat SaaS: telefon OTP orqali onlayn yozilish, shifokorlar jadvali va Telegram eslatmalari.
description.en: A multi-tenant appointment SaaS for private clinics: online booking with phone OTP, doctor schedules and Telegram reminders.

description.uz: Ijaraga berilgan uy-joy va kommunal hisob-kitob tizimi: shartnomalar, hisoblagich koʻrsatkichlari rasm bilan, oylik hisob-fakturalar va PDF.
description.en: A rental-property and utility billing manager: leases, photo meter readings, automatic monthly invoices and PDFs.

description.uz: Oilaviy kiyim doʻkonining qogʻoz qarz daftarini almashtiruvchi Telegram bot: qarzlar hisobi, avtomatik eslatmalar va oʻzbekcha matn hamda ovozli xabarni tushunadigan AI agent.
description.en: A Telegram bot that replaces a family clothing shop’s paper debt notebook: a debt ledger, automatic reminders and an AI agent that understands Uzbek text and voice messages.

description.uz: Nasiyaga savdo qiluvchi bizneslar uchun qarz undirishni avtomatlashtiruvchi multi-tenant SaaS: oʻzbek va rus tillarida AI muloqot, toʻlov vaʼdalari va boʻlib toʻlashni qayta tuzish.
description.en: A multi-tenant SaaS that automates debt collection for businesses selling on credit: AI outreach in Uzbek and Russian, payment-promise tracking and installment restructuring.

description.uz: Ingliz tili ustozi uchun ochiq sayt, ustoz va oʻquvchi kabinetlari; Telegram bildirishnomalari PostgreSQL outbox worker orqali yuboriladi.
description.en: A public website with teacher and student dashboards for an English teacher; Telegram notifications are sent through a PostgreSQL outbox worker.

description.uz: Oʻquv markazi uchun ommaviy sayt, CRM hamda oʻquvchi, ota-ona va xodim kabinetlari.
description.en: A public website, CRM and student, parent and staff dashboards for a learning centre.

description.uz: Fullstack internet-doʻkon: JWT bilan roʻyxatdan oʻtish, mahsulotlarni qidirish va saralash, savat va buyurtmalar.
description.en: A full-stack online store: JWT sign-up and login, product search and sorting, a cart and orders.

description.uz: Postlarni Telegram kanalingizga tez joylash uchun platforma: hisob, postlar tahriri va Bot API orqali nashr.
description.en: A platform for publishing posts to your Telegram channel fast: accounts, post editing and publishing through the Bot API.

description.uz: Telegram kanallarini real vaqtda kuzatib, namoz vaqtlari haqidagi postlarni kalit soʻzlar boʻyicha topadi va kerakli joyga darhol yuboradi.
description.en: Watches Telegram channels in real time, finds prayer-time posts by keyword and forwards them instantly.

description.uz: Maishiy texnika sotuvchi doʻkon uchun sayt va uning backend qismi.
description.en: A website for a household-appliance store, with its own backend.
